results.title: Novanta to Present at the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference on Wednesday, November 11, 2026
results.description: Novanta Inc. (Nasdaq: NOVT) (the "Company"), a trusted technology partner to medical and advanced technology equipment manufacturers, announced today that Robert Buckley, Chief Financial Officer, and John Lesica, Chief Operating Officer of Medical Solutions, are scheduled to present at the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, in Chicago, Illinois.
